verdict.rationale: A programmatic control API is a fair question for a terminal app, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only interactive use (gestures, keyboard shortcuts, typed ssh/mosh commands) and in-shell python/lua scripting, which is not an external API for driving the app. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
